name: Blumenia - Historias de un Mundo de Plantas
source:
Blumenia is a visual novel where its characters represent each a real life plant.

Meet its characters and discover their stories and the things that make each of them unique.

Their world is affected by a drought and they need to find the solution before it's too late.

A clue takes our protagonists into a journey between The Four Seasons, where they'll meet other plants and face different problems in each season.

Discover the truth of their world and bring back things to normality!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3298390/Blumenia__Historias_de_un_Mundo_de_Plantas/]Steam[/url]]
